ir_gluco_ir.name: Gluco IR
ir_gluco_ir.key: Per 5 capsules: 100 mg dihydroberberine, 300 mg alpha-lipoic acid, 600 mcg chromium, 2,000 mcg biotin, 500 mg Ceylon cinnamon, 200 mg gymnema, plus fenugreek, nettle, bitter melon, green tea and banaba
ir_gluco_ir.src: NutriDyn sell sheet Gluco IR SS ND506 Rev. 11/25 (Dropbox /NutriDyn/Sales/Practitioner Resource/NutriDyn Marketing Materials/Gluco IR SS ND506.pdf, read 2026-11-03). Supplement Facts, serving size 5 capsules, 30 servings: biotin 2,000 mcg (6,667% DV), chromium (as chromium picolinate) 600 mcg (1,714% DV), Ceylon cinnamon powder 500 mg, stinging nettle powder 500 mg, fenugreek extract 500 mg, alpha lipoic acid 300 mg, bitter melon extract 250 mg, green tea extract 200 mg, Gymnema sylvestre extract 200 mg, dihydroberberine (GlucoVantage) 100 mg, banaba extract 50 mg. Directions: 'Take five capsules daily'. Claims used on the card: 'Promotes healthy blood glucose levels already in the normal range'; chromium 'helps support the action of insulin'. The same amounts for nine of the eleven ingredients are in the product DB (scratchpad products/nutridyn_products.json R960, catalog ND143 10/1/26 as read by the switch charts). Size: ND144 price list 10/1/26 'R960 150C'. URL: repo blasts/2026-09-22-gluco-ir-back.html. 'With meals': Asher's blood-sugar patient handout (repo handouts/blood-sugar-patient-handout.pdf: 'Take your Gluco IR with a meal inside your eating window, five capsules a day or as your provider directs'); the handout gives no split. '3 with breakfast + 2 with the evening meal' is this sheet's suggested split of the label's five a day, the same split as the shared gluco_ir entry. Sheet-local key: the shared gluco_ir line used by other sheets is unchanged. Trade name: the card prints 'dihydroberberine' without 'GlucoVantage', a registered trademark of NNB Nutrition (ND1130's attribution line, re-opened 2026-11-03), so it needs neither the mark nor the attribution.

ir_berberine.name: Berberine Pro
ir_berberine.key: Per capsule: 100 mg dihydroberberine + 84 mg organic Ceylon cinnamon bark extract
ir_berberine.src: NutriDyn sell sheet Berberine Pro SS ND1130 Rev. 11/25 (Dropbox /NutriDyn/Sales/Practitioner Resource/NutriDyn Marketing Materials/Berberine Pro SS ND1130.pdf, read 2026-11-03). Supplement Facts, serving size 1 capsule, 90 servings: dihydroberberine (GlucoVantage) 100 mg, organic cinnamon extract (bark; Cinnamomum ceylon) 84 mg. Directions: 'Take one capsule three times daily before meals'. Claims used on the card: 'Promotes healthy glucose metabolism'; 'Supports heart health & optimal lipid balance'. Same facts in the product DB (R2125). ND1130 re-opened 2026-11-03: it prints 'GlucoVantage® is a registered trademark of NNB Nutrition', so the card says only 'dihydroberberine'; its caution reads 'If you are pregnant, nursing, or taking medication, consult your healthcare practitioner'. NutriDyn GLC 2026 insulin-resistance protocol PDF (via scratchpad wf/protocol-insulin-resistance.json): 'Berberine Pro: 1 cap TID wf'; the sheet prints the label timing (before meals). The rhythm keeps three separate doses; the breakfast and lunch doses share the Morning box, with the lunch dose spelled out, because the shared rhythm has no midday slot (the PCOS and fatty-liver sheets file it the same way). URL: Asher's 'Own Every Protocol' artifact links https://nutridyn.com/berberine-pro, the same link and source as the fatty-liver and PCOS sheets.

ir_akk.name: UltraBiotic Akkermansia Plus
ir_akk.key: Per capsule: 500 million TFU Akkermansia muciniphila (80% pasteurized), 22 billion CFU B. animalis and L. rhamnosus GG, 30 million CFU C. butyricum
ir_akk.src: NutriDyn sell sheet UltraBiotic Akkermansia Plus SS ND1194 Rev. 3/25 (Dropbox /NutriDyn/Sales/Practitioner Resource/NutriDyn Marketing Materials/UltraBiotic Akkermansia Plus SS ND1194.pdf, read 2026-11-03). Supplement Facts, serving size 1 capsule: Bifidobacterium animalis HN019 10 Billion CFU, Bifidobacterium animalis B420 10 Billion CFU, Lactobacillus rhamnosus GG 2 Billion CFU, Akkermansia muciniphila AH39 500 Million TFU (80% pasteurized cells and 20% live cells), Clostridium butyricum 30 Million CFU, all at time of manufacture; digestive-resistant capsule. The printed '22 billion CFU B. animalis and L. rhamnosus GG' is the label's 10 + 10 + 2 billion for HN019, B420 and LGG. Directions: 'Take one capsule daily'. Claims used on the card: 'Support healthy glucose metabolism'; 'Promote effective weight management'; 'Promote healthy gut barrier function'. Same strains and amounts in the product DB (R196, Pendulum chart, catalog ND143 10/1/26). Size: ND144 price list 10/1/26 'R196 30C'. Protocol: NutriDyn GLC 2024 metabolic-syndrome protocol PDF ('UltraBiotic Akkermansia Plus - Mucin and SCFA Support: 1 capsule daily', via scratchpad protocols/metabolic.md); Asher's Direct Mail launch blast 'NutriDyn New Formula: Akkermansia Plus' (2024-05-09) ties it to blood sugar balance. Timing: the label gives none, so the dose box says 'any time, such as bedtime' and the daily rhythm places the capsule at bedtime, the sheet's own suggestion (it is the one pill not tied to a meal). ND1194 re-opened 2026-11-03: '400 million TFU of pasteurized Akkermansia muciniphila and 100 million CFU of live Akkermansia muciniphila', so the capsule carries live bacteria (the rx notes ask people with a weak immune system to check first). Photo: no NutriDyn render or print master is staged. The kit prints img-src/R196.png, a smooth 4x stopgap (348x640) of the 160 px NutriDyn bottle thumbnail in the product DB (scratchpad products/img/R196.png), marked SOFT; that thumbnail is cropped to the bottle, so the module draws it at 0.91 of the photo height to match the other bottles' framing (AKK_FIT_CSS in conditions/insulin_resistance.py). Dropbox /NutriDyn/Product Images/Product Images (1)/ holds NutriDyn's own R196.png and R196L_Web, byte sizes in the range of that folder's 420 px web renders, which pass the kit's 300 px rule (products.MIN_PRINT_PX; the old 600 px bar is retired). The Dropbox content host is blocked from these sessions, so the photo needs central staging or Asher's print master; never an AI upscale, which rewrites label text. URL: the nutridyn.com catalog search for the product name, as the kit built it before the name took its no-break space (no verified product-page slug); pinned so the search keeps a plain space.

ir_ala.name: Alpha-Lipoic Acid
ir_ala.src: NutriDyn sell sheet Alpha Lipoic Acid SS ND283 Rev. 8/24 (Dropbox /NutriDyn/Sales/Practitioner Resource/NutriDyn Marketing Materials/Alpha Lipoic Acid SS ND283.pdf, read 2026-11-03; same panel in scratchpad labels/labels.json R270). Supplement Facts: serving size 1 capsule, 100 servings, alpha-lipoic acid 200 mg. Directions: 'Adults take one capsule daily'. Claims used on the card: 'Supports healthy blood sugar balance'; 'supporting antioxidant activity in the body and energy production from carbohydrates'. Timing: the same sell sheet says 'supplementation prior to consuming a carbohydrate-based meal may support healthy blood glucose levels', so the one daily capsule goes before breakfast. The NutriDyn GLC 2026 insulin-resistance protocol PDF writes 'Alpha-Lipoic Acid 200 mg: 1 cap TID'; the sheet prints the label dose and leaves a higher dose to the practitioner. Size: ND144 price list 10/1/26 'Alpha-Lipoic Acid R270 100C'. ON THE SHEET ONLY WITH ITS PHOTO: the only R270 image staged anywhere (scratchpad products/img/R270.png, 122x160, from the switch charts) shows the Progressive Professional Alpha Lipoic Acid bottle, 60 capsules, which is P872, not NutriDyn R270 (100 capsules): never use it. Dropbox /NutriDyn/Product Images/Product Images (1)/ holds the real R270 bottle as R270R.png and R270_Web, byte sizes in the range of that folder's 420 px web renders, which pass the kit's 300 px rule (products.MIN_PRINT_PX; the old 600 px bar is retired); the Dropbox content host is blocked from these sessions. img_src points at build/img-src/ir_ala.png, which does not exist yet, so nothing wrong is staged. Once build.py stages a print-ready photo for this key (an original 300 px or taller, not a SOFT stopgap), conditions/insulin_resistance.py puts this card in column 3 by itself (ALA, OPEN ITEM). No verified product-page slug, so the link falls back to the nutridyn.com catalog search.

ir_omega.name: Omega Pure EPA‑DHA 1000
ir_omega.key: Per softgel: 1,000 mg EPA + DHA (730 mg EPA, 270 mg DHA) from anchovy, sardine and mackerel
ir_omega.src: NutriDyn sell sheet Omega Pure EPA-DHA 1000 SS ND416 Rev. 4/25 (Dropbox /NutriDyn/Sales/Practitioner Resource/NutriDyn Marketing Materials/Omega Pure EPA-DHA 1000 SS ND416.pdf, read 2026-11-03). Supplement Facts, serving size 1 softgel, 120 servings: total omega-3 fatty acids 1.1 g, EPA 730 mg, DHA 270 mg, additional omega-3 100 mg; contains fish (anchovy, sardine, mackerel). Directions: 'Take one softgel 1-3 times daily with food'; the same sheet: EPA + DHA of 1,000-3,000 mg a day 'comes out to 1-2 servings of Omega Pure EPA-DHA 1000 daily'. Claims used on the card (ND416 re-opened 2026-11-03): 'Healthy cardiovascular function'; and EPA and DHA are found 'especially in cell membranes, making them integral components of membrane phospholipids' (bullet 2, 'Supports healthy cell membranes'). ND416 makes no triglyceride claim, so the card makes none. 'In each serving' ends at the fish names: ND416 lists 'Highly concentrated omega-3 fish oil (anchovy, sardine, mackerel)'. Same amounts in the product DB (R243). NutriDyn GLC 2026 insulin-resistance protocol PDF: 'Omega Pure EPA-DHA 1000: 2 softgels BID wf where triglycerides are raised' (4 a day, above the label's 3); the sheet prints 2 a day with food, inside the label. URL slug from products.py SLUGS (NutriDyn 60-day protocol doc). Name: a no-break hyphen and a no-break space keep 'EPA-DHA 1000' on one line, as on the bottle (kit.print_safe prints the hyphen as a plain one inside an unbreakable span); same name string as the high-blood-pressure, neuropathy, PCOS and tendon-shoulder sheets.
